rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, but then performed a write (modify_pending_order_items) without any visible explicit confirmation from the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. It also used PayPal as the payment method despite the user’s stated preference to pay the difference with a gift card first, with no evidence that a gift card was attempted or impossible. There is no evidence the agent ensured the shoe size stayed the same, nor any final, correct summary of changes communicated to the user; the only visible final message is a generic closing. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
